title: VisualPRM: An Effective Process Reward Model for Multimodal Reasoning
authors_zh: Weiyun Wang、Zhangwei Gao、Lianjie Chen、Zhe Chen、Jinguo Zhu、Xiangyu Zhao、Yangzhou Liu、Yue Cao、Shenglong Ye、Xizhou Zhu、Lewei Lu、Haodong Duan、Yu Qiao、Jifeng Dai、Wenhai Wang
paper_type_zh: Rollout、搜索或测试时轨迹研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计推理轨迹、反馈契约、选择机制与复现边界的读者
one_line: VisualPRM400K converts 16-continuation prefix success rates into binary multimodal step labels for an 8B PRM, but the original release omits the continuation and decision ledger behind those labels.
VisualPRM400K 把 16 次续写的前缀成功率转成二元多模态步骤标签用于训练 8B 过程奖励模型，但原始发布未包含这些标签背后的续写记录与判定台账。
why: It is a concrete open example of how training-time rollout labels feed a process scorer and then a test-time Best-of-N selector, making rollout budget, terminal checking, version identity, and rejected traces central audit objects rather than implementation trivia.
inclusion_reason: VisualPRM links multimodal solution prefixes to Monte Carlo process values and releases the derived training set, reward model, and a separate human-labeled benchmark. It belongs in rollout/search/test-time trace data because both label construction and Best-of-N depend on repeated samples, while the underlying continuations and selection logs remain an important missing layer.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Multimodal Best-of-N needs a critic that can distinguish reasoning candidates using both the image and the evolving solution. An outcome score collapses a response into one final judgment, while a process reward model scores intermediate steps. The practical bottleneck is therefore not only model architecture: it is a data object that connects an image, a question, a solution prefix, the next step, and an evidence-backed step target.

VisualPRM separates three public objects that should not be conflated. VisualPRM400K is automatically constructed training data; VisualPRM-8B is the learned process reward model; VisualProcessBench is a separate human-annotated test set for step-error detection. The training labels are Monte Carlo estimates converted to binary targets, whereas benchmark labels come from human experts. Performance on VisualProcessBench or downstream Best-of-N tasks does not prove that every VisualPRM400K label is correct.

This work belongs in rollout_search_test_time_trace_data because repeated sampling appears twice. During data construction, each solution prefix is expanded with 16 continuations to estimate its future success. During inference, a policy samples N complete candidate responses and VisualPRM selects one by an aggregate step score. The original release publishes the derived training conversations but not the underlying continuation rollouts, rejected candidates, or Best-of-N decision logs, so the selector can be used without the full trace lineage being auditable.

多模态 Best-of-N 需要一个能够同时依据图像和持续展开的解题过程区分候选答案的 critic。Outcome score 把整段回答压缩为一次终局判断，而 process reward model 对中间步骤逐步评分。因此，实际瓶颈不仅是模型架构，还包括一种能够关联图像、问题、解答前缀、当前步骤与有证据支撑的步骤目标的数据对象。

VisualPRM 公开了三个必须区分的对象：VisualPRM400K 是自动构造的训练数据；VisualPRM-8B 是学得的过程奖励模型；VisualProcessBench 是独立的人工步骤错误检测测试集。训练标签来自 Monte Carlo 估计后再离散为二元目标，benchmark 标签则由人工专家给出。VisualProcessBench 或下游 Best-of-N 的表现不能证明 VisualPRM400K 的每个标签都正确。

该工作属于 rollout_search_test_time_trace_data，因为重复采样在两个阶段出现。构造数据时，每个解答前缀扩展 16 条 continuation，以估计后续成功概率；推理时，policy 采样 N 个完整候选，再由 VisualPRM 根据聚合步骤分选择其中一个。原始发布提供了派生后的训练 conversation，却没有发布底层 continuation rollout、被拒候选或 Best-of-N 决策日志，因此使用者可以运行 selector，但无法完整审计 trace lineage。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
For an image I, question q, and a solution split into steps, VisualPRM400K assigns each prefix a Monte Carlo expected accuracy. From prefix s_1:i, an InternVL2.5-series model samples 16 completions. If k completions end with an answer accepted by the source-dependent checker, mc_i = k/16. The released value-based target is '+' when mc_i > 0 and '-' when mc_i = 0. This is an any-success rule: one accepted completion is enough to mark the current prefix positive.

The conceptual record contains the image, question, ordered steps, and mc_i values. For training, it is rendered as a multi-turn conversation. The first user turn includes the image, question, and first step; each later user turn introduces one additional step; the paired assistant output is the discrete quality token. VisualPRM is conditioned on the full available visual/problem context and preceding steps when predicting the current label.

At inference, a step score is the probability-weighted value of the discrete output tokens. The reported value-based model uses positive/negative outputs; the paper also studies an advantage variant with superior/equal/inferior targets derived from changes in mc_i. Step scores are aggregated by their mean unless another ablation is specified, producing a response-level value used to rank Best-of-N candidates.

The scorer is not the same as the construction verifier. Terminal answer checkers create the Monte Carlo targets; VisualPRM learns to imitate the resulting process labels; Best-of-N then uses the learned scores for selection. Errors or biases in the continuation generator and answer checker can therefore propagate into the learned reward even when the model later performs well on a benchmark.

对图像 I、问题 q 和被切分为步骤的解答，VisualPRM400K 为每个前缀分配 Monte Carlo expected accuracy。从前缀 s_1:i 出发，InternVL2.5 系列模型采样 16 条 continuation；若其中 k 条的终局答案被按来源选择的 checker 接受，则 mc_i = k/16。公开的 value-based 目标在 mc_i > 0 时为 +，mc_i = 0 时为 -。这是“任一成功”规则：只要一条 continuation 通过，就把当前前缀标为正例。

概念记录包含图像、问题、有序步骤和各步 mc_i。训练时，它被渲染为多轮 conversation：第一轮 user 内容包含图像、问题和第一步，后续每轮 user 再加入一个步骤，对应 assistant 输出离散质量 token。VisualPRM 在预测当前标签时，会利用已有的完整视觉/问题上下文和此前步骤。

推理时，单步分数由离散输出 token 的生成概率加权得到。论文主要使用正/负输出的 value-based 模型，也研究基于 mc_i 变化构造 superior/equal/inferior 目标的 advantage 变体。除非消融另有设置，否则完整回答分数取各步骤分数均值，并据此排列 Best-of-N 候选。

这个 scorer 并不等同于数据构造 verifier。终局答案 checker 产生 Monte Carlo 目标，VisualPRM 学习这些过程标签，Best-of-N 再使用学得分数做选择。因此，即使模型之后在 benchmark 上表现较好，continuation generator 与答案 checker 的错误或偏差仍可能进入学得奖励。

title: Method
方法
html:
Images and questions come from MMPR v1.1. The paper shows general VQA, science, chart, mathematics, OCR, and document examples, but does not provide a paper-snapshot mixture table. InternVL2.5-series models sample four independent step-by-step solutions for every image-question pair. Exact checkpoint sizes, assignment across sources, prompts, seeds, and construction temperature are unknown.

Each solution is split on step boundaries. If it contains more than 12 steps, adjacent material is evenly merged until at most 12 units remain. For each retained prefix, the generator samples 16 completions. A terminal checker compares every extracted final answer with the source answer; mc_i is the accepted fraction. The paper defines the positive label as mc_i > 0 and the negative label as mc_i = 0, and supervises every stored step rather than cutting the example after the first negative step.

This recipe yields about 400K solution samples and about 2M supervised steps. A response averages 126.9 words and 5.6 steps; a step averages 22.6 words; about 10% of steps are negative. These are aggregate paper statistics, not a released per-source or per-generator manifest. The original public dataset converts mc_i to +/- conversation targets. Its archive does not expose the 16 continuation texts, parser outputs, or seeds that produced each label.

The paper does not define the paper-time terminal checker for every MMPR source. Later official InternVL code selects match logic from dataset names and combines exact matching with task-dependent VQA, multiple-choice, numerical, LaTeX, and Math-Verify-style checks. That code confirms a plausible automated verifier family and exposes default 4/16/12 arguments, but it was released after the paper and current scripts also target later InternVL3/v1.1 construction. It cannot be treated as an immutable original-run specification.

VisualPRM is trained as a multi-turn generative classifier. It uses packed training for one epoch with AdamW, beta1 0.9, beta2 0.999, weight decay 0.05, learning rate 1e-5, a 5% linear warmup, and cosine decay to zero. At scoring time, the probability mass on the discrete quality tokens is converted to a scalar for each step and mean-aggregated over the response.

VisualProcessBench is built separately. It contains 2,866 questions from MMMU, MathVision, MathVerse Vision-Only, DynaMath, and WeMath, paired with model-generated solutions and 26,950 human step labels: 16,585 positive, 7,691 negative, and 2,674 neutral. Thirteen annotators with at least a university degree worked for three days. Authors spot-checked about 10% of each of ten roughly 300-sample splits and returned erroneous splits for re-annotation. The public test rows contain image paths, question, answer, response steps, process_correctness, policy_model, and data_source.

For test-time selection, policy models generate distinct reasoning candidates at temperature 0.7. N=8 is the default reported setting, with ablations through N=128. VisualPRM selects the response with the highest mean step score. Candidate sets, per-step scores, ties, and rejected responses are not part of the released paper artifacts.

图像与问题来自 MMPR v1.1。论文展示了通用 VQA、科学、图表、数学、OCR 和文档等领域的样例，但没有给出论文快照对应的混合比例表。InternVL2.5 系列模型为每个图问对采样四个独立的分步解答；具体 checkpoint 规模、不同来源的分配、输入指令、随机种子和构造温度均为 unknown。

每个解答按步骤边界切分。如果超过 12 步，就均匀合并相邻内容，直到最多保留 12 个单元。对每个保留前缀，生成器采样 16 条 continuation；终局 checker 把每条抽取出的最终答案与来源答案比较，mc_i 为通过比例。论文规定 mc_i > 0 时标正，mc_i = 0 时标负，并监督所有已存步骤，而不是在第一处负例后截断样本。

该配方得到约 40 万个解答样本和约 200 万个受监督步骤。每个回答平均 126.9 个词、5.6 步，每步平均 22.6 个词，约 10% 的步骤为负例。这些是论文级聚合统计，不是按来源或 generator 发布的 manifest。原始公开数据把 mc_i 转换为 +/- conversation 目标，归档中没有暴露产生每个标签的 16 条 continuation 文本、parser 输出或随机种子。

论文没有说明每个 MMPR 来源在论文运行时使用的终局 checker。后续官方 InternVL 代码按数据集名称选择匹配逻辑，并组合精确匹配、VQA、多项选择、数值、LaTeX 和 Math-Verify 风格检查。该代码证明了一个可用的自动验证器族，也暴露了 4/16/12 默认参数，但它发布于论文之后，当前脚本还覆盖后来的 InternVL3/v1.1 构造，因此不能视为原始运行的不可变规格。

VisualPRM 作为多轮生成式分类器训练。流程使用 data packing，训练一轮；AdamW 的 beta1 为 0.9、beta2 为 0.999、weight decay 为 0.05，初始学习率 1e-5，前 5% step 线性 warmup，随后 cosine decay 到 0。评分时，把离散质量 token 的概率转换为每步标量，再对整段回答取均值。

VisualProcessBench 独立构造。它包含来自 MMMU、MathVision、MathVerse Vision-Only、DynaMath 和 WeMath 的 2,866 个问题，以及模型生成的解答和 26,950 个人工步骤标签：16,585 个正例、7,691 个负例、2,674 个 neutral。13 名至少具有大学学历的标注员工作三天；作者把数据划成十个约 300 样本的 split，每个 split 抽查约 10%，有错误的 split 退回重标。公开 test 行包含 image path、question、answer、response steps、process_correctness、policy_model 和 data_source。

测试时选择阶段，policy model 以温度 0.7 生成不同推理候选。论文默认 N=8，并消融到 N=128；VisualPRM 选择平均步骤分最高的回答。候选集合、逐步分数、并列处理和被拒回答均未包含在论文发布资产中。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper and TeX source establish the exact construction counts: four initial solutions per image-question pair, 16 continuations per prefix, a maximum of 12 stored/merged steps, about 400K response samples, and about 2M supervised steps. They also establish the threshold mc_i > 0, all-step supervision, the reported optimizer schedule, and the separate human-annotation procedure for VisualProcessBench.

The official release surface is material. VisualPRM400K is public as an ungated approximately 72.7 GB repository with annotation and split image archives; its card says expected accuracies were converted to binary conversation labels. VisualPRM-8B is public as an 8B safetensors checkpoint. VisualProcessBench is public as a 510 MB artifact whose test JSONL reproduces all 2,866 rows, source counts, four policy-model families, 26,950 steps, and the 16,585/7,691/2,674 label totals reported in the table. Official InternVL code later exposes construction and post-processing scripts.

The empirical evidence tests two different capabilities. VisualProcessBench measures binary step-error detection with macro F1 after excluding neutral steps; VisualPRM reports overall F1 62.0. Best-of-N experiments measure whether its mean step score selects better complete responses than controls under the authors' candidate distribution. The paper reports N=8 gains across seven visual benchmarks and further scaling to N=128 for two policy models.

Those results support the claim that the learned scorer can be useful under the evaluated setup. They do not validate every automatic training label, prove the source mixture is uncontaminated, establish upstream rights, or show that the same scorer is calibrated for arbitrary generators. The paper itself attributes some modeling difficulty to noise in the automatically generated data, and stricter positive thresholds reduce aggregate results rather than resolving label truth.

Release verification also reveals version boundaries. The original VisualPRM400K release contains derived conversation labels. A later VisualPRM400K-v1.1 adds sources and prompts, and VisualPRM400K-v1.1-Raw exposes score, num_mc_correct, and num_mc_total fields. These later records demonstrate a richer schema but are not evidence that original-version raw rollouts were published.

论文与 TeX 源文件给出了精确构造数量：每个图问对四个初始解答、每个前缀 16 条 continuation、最多 12 个存储/合并步骤、约 40 万个回答样本和约 200 万个受监督步骤。它们也确认了 mc_i > 0 阈值、全步骤监督、所报告的优化器日程，以及 VisualProcessBench 独立的人工标注流程。

官方发布面较完整。VisualPRM400K 是无需申请即可访问的约 72.7 GB 仓库，包含 annotation 和分片 image 归档；其 dataset card 明确 expected accuracy 已转换为二元 conversation 标签。VisualPRM-8B 以 8B safetensors 权重发布。VisualProcessBench 是约 510 MB 的资产；其 test JSONL 可复核全部 2,866 行、来源计数、四类 policy model、26,950 个步骤，以及论文表格中的 16,585/7,691/2,674 标签总数。官方 InternVL 仓库后来还发布了构造与后处理脚本。

实验证据检验两类不同能力。VisualProcessBench 在排除 neutral 步骤后，用 macro F1 衡量二元步骤错误检测；VisualPRM 报告 overall F1 62.0。Best-of-N 实验则衡量在作者候选分布下，平均步骤分是否比对照方法更能选中正确完整回答。论文报告了 N=8 时七个视觉 benchmark 上的提升，并对两个 policy model 扩展到 N=128。

这些结果支持“学得的 scorer 在所评设置下有用”，但不能逐条验证自动训练标签、证明来源混合无污染、建立上游权利，或说明同一 scorer 对任意 generator 都已校准。论文自身把部分建模困难归因于自动数据噪声，而更严格的正例阈值会降低聚合结果，并没有解决标签真值问题。

发布核验还显示了版本边界。原始 VisualPRM400K 发布的是派生 conversation 标签；后续 VisualPRM400K-v1.1 增加来源与输入指令，VisualPRM400K-v1.1-Raw 才暴露 score、num_mc_correct 和 num_mc_total 字段。这些后续记录证明可以采用更丰富 schema，却不能证明原始版本的 raw rollout 已经发布。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The data contribution extends Monte Carlo process supervision from text-only mathematics to image-conditioned reasoning. A label is attached to a visual solution prefix, not just a textual step in isolation. The construction therefore couples visual input, question semantics, step segmentation, continuation sampling, terminal answer checking, and process-value estimation.

The model contribution reformulates step scoring as a multi-turn multimodal conversation so an existing generative MLLM can emit discrete quality tokens. It supervises all stored steps, including those after an earlier negative label, which preserves examples where a later step may correct the trajectory. Mean aggregation then turns step probabilities into a response score for Best-of-N.

VisualProcessBench provides a separate human-labeled measurement object. Instead of asking only for the first error, it labels every step positive, negative, or neutral and evaluates error detection across five visual-reasoning sources. This separation is useful because an automatically generated training target and a human evaluation label have different evidence status.

None of the individual ingredients is wholly new: Monte Carlo rollouts, process reward modeling, discrete labels, step aggregation, and Best-of-N predate the paper. The novelty is their multimodal integration plus an open dataset/model/benchmark package. The original continuation and selection traces remain absent, so the release advances reuse more than complete construction auditability.

数据贡献把 Monte Carlo 过程监督从纯文本数学扩展到图像条件推理。标签附着在视觉解答前缀上，而不是孤立的文本步骤；因此构造过程把视觉输入、问题语义、步骤切分、continuation 采样、终局答案检查和过程价值估计连接起来。

模型贡献把步骤评分改写为多轮多模态 conversation，使现有生成式 MLLM 能输出离散质量 token。它监督所有已存步骤，包括此前出现负标签之后的步骤，从而保留后续步骤可能修正轨迹的样例。随后通过均值聚合，把步骤概率变成 Best-of-N 使用的回答分数。

VisualProcessBench 提供了独立的人工测量对象。它不只要求找到第一处错误，而是把每一步标为 positive、negative 或 neutral，并在五个视觉推理来源上评估错误检测。这种分离很重要，因为自动生成的训练目标和人工评测标签具有不同证据地位。

各个组成部分本身并非全新：Monte Carlo rollout、process reward modeling、离散标签、步骤聚合和 Best-of-N 都已有先例。这里的新意是它们的多模态整合，以及开放的数据/模型/benchmark 组合。原始 continuation 与选择 trace 仍然缺失，所以该发布更显著地提升了可复用性，而不是完整构造可审计性。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The positive target is permissive. With 16 continuations and threshold mc_i > 0, one accepted terminal answer marks a prefix positive. A flawed step can therefore receive a positive label if the continuation model repairs it, guesses correctly, or the terminal checker accepts an equivalent-looking answer. Conversely, a sound but hard prefix is negative when all 16 samples fail.

Monte Carlo labels are model- and verifier-conditioned estimates, not direct expert judgments. The original generator checkpoints, prompts, temperature, seeds, answer-extraction rules, parser versions, and source-specific checker mapping are not fully disclosed. Current official code supplies several automatic checks, but it is later code without a paper-run tag and includes v1.1/InternVL3 workflows.

Step granularity is unstable. Even merging reduces any solution above 12 steps to larger chunks, so a single label can cover multiple logical operations. This can hide a local error or mix an error with its correction. The public conversation format also discards the scalar mc_i and the 16 underlying completion records, preventing sensitivity analysis or relabeling of the original version.

The class distribution is imbalanced: about 90% of VisualPRM400K steps are positive. VisualProcessBench reports that generic multimodal critics tend to over-predict positive labels, and the learned PRM can inherit a related bias. A reported macro F1 or Best-of-N gain does not certify calibration, subgroup performance, or per-source label reliability.

Data identity and separation remain partial. The original repository has a train split but no published validation split, source-count manifest, duplicate ledger, or decontamination report. VisualProcessBench and downstream evaluations use well-known visual benchmarks, while training prompts come through MMPR v1.1; exact image/question overlap is unknown.

Human benchmark annotation has its own gaps. The paper reports annotator education, labor, cost, per-split spot checking, and re-annotation, but not inter-annotator agreement, double-label coverage, adjudication history, or annotator-level error rates. The paper text lists Gemini-2.0-Flash as a solution generator, whereas the released rows and statistics allocate all 2,866 samples to four other model families.

Licensing is only top-level. The paper is CC BY 4.0 and the public code/data/model cards are labeled MIT, but no record-level matrix ties every MMPR-derived image/question and benchmark-derived test item to its upstream license and attribution. A repository label alone does not establish that all embedded content can be redistributed under one license.

Finally, neither construction-time continuation rollouts nor inference-time Best-of-N candidate sets are released. Researchers can train and run the scorer, but they cannot reconstruct every positive label, audit rejected alternatives, or attribute a reported gain among more sampling, a different candidate distribution, and a stronger selector from released logs alone.

正例目标较宽松。在 16 条 continuation 且阈值为 mc_i > 0 时，只要一个终局答案通过，就把前缀标正。因此，即使当前步骤有缺陷，只要 continuation model 修复了错误、猜中答案，或终局 checker 接受了表面等价答案，也可能得到正标签。反过来，一个合理但困难的前缀若 16 次都失败，就会被标负。

Monte Carlo 标签是受模型与 verifier 条件约束的估计，不是专家直接判断。原始 generator checkpoint、输入指令、温度、随机种子、答案抽取规则、parser 版本和按来源选择 checker 的映射均未完整披露。当前官方代码提供多类自动检查，但属于没有论文运行 tag 的后续实现，也包含 v1.1/InternVL3 流程。

步骤粒度并不稳定。均匀合并会把超过 12 步的解答压成更大的块，因此一个标签可能覆盖多个逻辑操作，掩盖局部错误，或把错误与修正混在一起。公开 conversation 格式还丢弃了标量 mc_i 和底层 16 条 completion 记录，使外部研究者无法对原始版本做敏感性分析或重新标注。

类别分布不平衡：VisualPRM400K 约 90% 的步骤为正例。VisualProcessBench 报告通用多模态 critic 容易过度预测正标签，学得的 PRM 也可能继承相关偏差。报告的 macro F1 或 Best-of-N 提升不能证明校准性、子群表现或各来源标签可靠性。

数据身份与隔离仍不完整。原始仓库只有 train split，没有公开 validation split、来源计数 manifest、重复记录账本或去污染报告。VisualProcessBench 与下游评估使用知名视觉 benchmark，而训练提示经 MMPR v1.1 汇入；图像/问题的精确重叠为 unknown。

人工 benchmark 标注也有缺口。论文说明了标注员学历、工作量、成本、按 split 抽查与返工，却没有报告标注员间一致性、双人标注覆盖、仲裁历史或个人错误率。论文正文把 Gemini-2.0-Flash 列为解答生成者，但公开行与统计表把全部 2,866 个样本分配给另外四类模型。

许可只在顶层给出。论文采用 CC BY 4.0，公开代码/数据/模型卡标为 MIT，但没有逐条矩阵把每个 MMPR 衍生图像/问题和 benchmark 衍生测试项连接到上游许可与署名。仓库标签本身不能证明所有嵌入内容都可以按单一许可重新分发。

最后，构造时 continuation rollout 与推理时 Best-of-N 候选集都未发布。研究者可以训练并运行 scorer，却无法逐条重建正标签、审计被拒替代项，或仅凭公开日志区分性能增益究竟来自更多采样、不同候选分布还是更强 selector。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For rollout_search_test_time_trace_data, VisualPRM is a useful two-stage case study. Training labels summarize a 16-rollout search from each prefix, while inference selects among N complete responses. The Card should therefore be used to audit both the label-generation budget and the test-time candidate budget, rather than treating the final +/- token or chosen answer as the complete data object.

The released original data can support multimodal PRM training, binary step classification, class-imbalance studies, aggregation ablations, and transfer tests across policy families. VisualPRM-8B can score candidate responses, and VisualProcessBench can evaluate positive/negative step detection. Users should pin the original release revision because v1.1 adds sources/prompts and the v1.1-Raw schema describes a changed dataset.

A stronger reproducible record would preserve upstream source ID and revision, image hash, question and answer, solution-generator checkpoint, initial-solution seed, exact step boundaries and merge map, all 16 continuation texts, extracted answers, checker modes/results, mc_i, binary label, and code/environment revision. For Best-of-N, retain N, policy checkpoint, temperature, every candidate, per-step scores, aggregate score, selected ID, ties, and rejected candidates.

The separate benchmark is valuable for comparing learned PRMs with prompted judges because it includes every step and neutral labels. Reusers should report class-wise F1, per-source results, and calibration, not only one overall number. They should also resolve overlap with training prompts and preserve the benchmark's policy_model and data_source fields.

This package is not evidence that any Monte Carlo label is a verified local proof step. It is better understood as estimated future solvability under one undisclosed generation/verifier stack. Downstream Best-of-N improvements motivate the scorer, but do not by themselves prove that the training dataset is clean, unbiased, licensed end to end, or optimal for another generator.

对 rollout_search_test_time_trace_data 而言，VisualPRM 是一个有用的两阶段案例：训练标签汇总从每个前缀出发的 16 次 rollout search，推理阶段则在 N 个完整回答中选择。因此，这张 Card 应同时审计标签生成预算和测试时候选预算，而不能把最终 +/- token 或被选答案当成完整数据对象。

公开的原始数据可用于多模态 PRM 训练、二元步骤分类、类别不平衡研究、聚合方法消融和跨 policy family 迁移测试。VisualPRM-8B 可以给候选回答打分，VisualProcessBench 可以评估正/负步骤检测。使用者应固定原始发布 revision，因为 v1.1 增加了来源与输入指令，v1.1-Raw schema 对应的是已经变化的数据集。

更强的可复现记录应保留上游 source ID 与版本、图像 hash、问题和答案、solution generator checkpoint、初始解答随机种子、精确步骤边界与 merge map、全部 16 条 continuation 文本、抽取答案、checker 模式/结果、mc_i、二元标签以及代码/环境 revision。对 Best-of-N，还应保留 N、policy checkpoint、温度、所有候选、逐步分数、聚合分、被选 ID、并列情况和被拒候选。

独立 benchmark 对比较学得 PRM 与 prompted judge 很有价值，因为它覆盖所有步骤并包含 neutral 标签。复用者应报告分类别 F1、按来源结果与校准，而不只给一个 overall 数字；还应检查训练提示重叠，并保留 benchmark 的 policy_model 和 data_source 字段。

这套发布不能证明任一 Monte Carlo 标签都是已经验证的局部证明步骤。更准确的理解是：它估计某前缀在一套未完整披露的生成/验证栈下的未来可解性。下游 Best-of-N 提升可以说明 scorer 值得研究，却不能单独证明训练数据干净、无偏、许可链完整，或对另一 generator 仍最优。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep three objects separate: VisualPRM400K is automatic training data, VisualPRM-8B is the learned scorer, and VisualProcessBench is a human-labeled test set.
  • The exact paper recipe is four initial solutions per image-question pair, at most 12 stored/merged steps, and 16 continuations per prefix.
  • A positive training label means mc_i > 0: at least one of 16 continuations passed the terminal checker. It does not mean a human verified the current step.
  • The original public data stores derived +/- conversation targets; later v1.1-Raw scalar/count fields belong to a changed release and are not an original rollout ledger.
  • Default Best-of-N uses N=8 at policy temperature 0.7, but its candidate and rejection traces are not released; report sampling and selector budgets together.
  • Read benchmark F1 and Best-of-N gains as model evaluation, not as proof of source cleanliness, decontamination, label correctness, or license completeness.

• 始终区分三个对象：VisualPRM400K 是自动训练数据，VisualPRM-8B 是学得的 scorer，VisualProcessBench 是人工标注测试集。
  • 论文精确配方是：每个图问对四个初始解答、最多 12 个存储/合并步骤、每个前缀 16 条 continuation。
  • 正训练标签表示 mc_i > 0，即 16 条 continuation 中至少一条通过终局 checker；它不表示人工验证了当前步骤。
  • 原始公开数据保存派生后的 +/- conversation 目标；后来的 v1.1-Raw 标量/计数字段属于变化后的发布，不是原始 rollout 账本。
  • 默认 Best-of-N 在 policy 温度 0.7 下使用 N=8，但没有发布候选与拒绝 trace；报告时应同时给出采样预算和 selector 预算。
  • benchmark F1 与 Best-of-N 提升属于模型评估，不能作为来源洁净度、去污染、标签正确性或许可完整性的证明。

value.html: VisualPRM400K takes images and questions from MMPR v1.1. The paper shows domains including general VQA, science, charts, mathematics, OCR, and documents, but does not publish a paper-version source-count table, immutable upstream record mapping, or source-level license matrix.

The conceptual construction record contains an image, question, one solution split into steps, and an expected-accuracy value mc_i for each prefix. The original public VisualPRM400K converts these values into multi-turn conversations: the first user turn contains image, question, and step 1; later user turns add one step; assistant turns emit a discrete '+' or '-' step label. The later VisualPRM400K-v1.1-Raw exposes step text, score, num_mc_correct, and num_mc_total, but it is a different version and not an immutable raw snapshot of the original paper data.

InternVL2.5-series models generate four step-by-step solutions for each image-question pair and also generate Monte Carlo continuations from every solution prefix. Exact generator checkpoint allocation and per-record generator identity for the original paper release are unknown.

Offline multimodal generation and verification over MMPR v1.1 images/questions. There is no interactive environment; the relevant substrate is the image-question record, InternVL2.5 generation stack, step splitter/merger, continuation sampler, and terminal-answer checker.

For each prefix, 16 sampled completions are checked against the source ground-truth answer; mc_i is the fraction judged correct. A value-based label is '+' when mc_i > 0 and '-' when mc_i = 0, so one successful continuation is sufficient for a positive label. The paper does not specify the exact paper-time checker for every source. Later official code provides dataset-dependent exact, VQA, multiple-choice, numerical, LaTeX, and Math-Verify-style checks, but it is not a tagged record of the original run.

A continuation terminates with an extracted final answer and contributes 1 when the source-dependent checker accepts it against the ground-truth answer, otherwise 0. The paper-level extraction rules, parser versions, fallbacks, and failure handling are unknown. VisualPRM itself predicts step tokens and is not the terminal verifier that created the labels.

The released VisualPRM-8B is an 8B InternVL-family reward model. Official Hugging Face metadata names OpenGVLab/InternVL2_5-8B and OpenGVLab/InternVL2_5-8B-MPO in its base lineage and lists MMPR-v1.1 plus VisualPRM400K as training datasets; the paper does not fully specify the checkpoint initialization or mixture relationship.

InternVL2.5-series models generate original solutions and Monte Carlo continuations. The exact sizes, revisions, per-source assignment, and whether one or several checkpoints produced each record are unknown.

For every image-question pair, sample four candidate solutions. Split each solution into steps; if it exceeds 12 steps, evenly merge adjacent text into at most 12 units. For each retained prefix, sample 16 completions, check terminal answers, and store mc_i as the successful-completion fraction before converting it to a discrete step label.

Four initial solutions are sampled per image-question pair; every retained step prefix receives 16 Monte Carlo continuations; solutions are capped by merging to 12 stored steps. The resulting paper dataset has about 400K solution samples and 2M supervised steps, averaging 5.6 steps and 126.9 words per response and 22.6 words per step; about 10% of steps receive the negative label.

The paper does not disclose the construction temperature for VisualPRM400K. Best-of-N evaluation samples policy responses at temperature 0.7; this evaluation setting must not be transferred to training-data construction.

The main label rule uses threshold 0: mc_i > 0 is positive and mc_i = 0 is negative. All steps are supervised rather than stopping training labels after the first error. The paper reports testing stricter thresholds and finding worse aggregate PRM results. It does not publish source-removal filters, failed-generation counts, parser-failure counts, duplicate filters, or an accepted/rejected ledger.

Training-label construction uses 4 initial solutions per image-question pair, 16 continuations per retained prefix, and at most 12 stored/merged steps. Best-of-N uses N=8 by default and reports scaling through N=128; the sampled candidate responses and selector logs are not released.

VisualPRM uses packed training for one epoch with AdamW (beta1=0.9, beta2=0.999, weight decay 0.05), initial learning rate 1e-5, linear warmup over the first 5% of steps, and cosine decay to zero. It predicts discrete step-quality tokens in a multi-turn chat formulation and averages probability-weighted step scores to rank a full response.

The paper attributes images/questions to MMPR v1.1 and solutions to InternVL2.5-series sampling. It reports broad visual-reasoning domains but no per-source record counts, upstream IDs, generator mixture, collection dates, or paper-snapshot manifest. The current original dataset repository is a 72.7 GB archive with one train split and separate image/annotation archives.

The original VisualPRM400K repository exposes a train split and no documented validation/test split. VisualProcessBench is a separate 2,866-row test artifact. Independence between VisualPRM400K/MMPR v1.1 prompts and VisualProcessBench or the seven Best-of-N evaluation benchmarks is not established by a released mapping.

unknown. No exact, near-duplicate, image-hash, question-semantic, or source-ID overlap ledger was verified between MMPR v1.1-derived training prompts and VisualProcessBench, MMMU, MathVista, MathVision, MathVerse, DynaMath, WeMath, LogicVista, or the text-only evaluations.

items: The mc_i > 0 rule labels a prefix positive when only one of 16 continuations succeeds, so recovery by the continuation model or a lucky sample can mask an erroneous current step.

Monte Carlo values depend on the continuation checkpoint, prompt formatting, temperature, seed, rollout count, answer extractor, and source-specific checker; most of these paper-run details are unknown.
Evenly merging long solutions into at most 12 units can combine correct and incorrect reasoning into one supervision target and hide the location of a local error.
About 90% of training steps are positive, creating class imbalance; benchmark results show that generic multimodal critics can already be biased toward positive judgments.

The original public training format stores discrete labels rather than the full Monte Carlo decision record. The later v1.1-Raw release exposes scalar counts for a changed dataset version and cannot substitute for an original-version rollout ledger.

Current official construction code was released after the paper and includes later InternVL3/v1.1 scripts. Without a paper-tagged commit and run manifest, current defaults do not prove the exact original configuration.
VisualProcessBench uses expert labels and author spot checks but reports no inter-annotator agreement or per-item adjudication history. Neutral steps are excluded from binary F1 evaluation.

The paper text names Gemini-2.0-Flash among benchmark solution generators, while the released 2,866 rows and paper count table contain GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, QvQ-72B-Preview, and InternVL2.5-78B only.
The released artifacts do not provide a source-level decontamination report or record-level upstream license matrix.

value.html: The arXiv paper is CC BY 4.0; the official InternVL repository, VisualPRM-8B model card, VisualPRM400K dataset card, and VisualProcessBench card are labeled MIT, with an Apache-2.0 notice for an InternLM component. These top-level labels do not replace record-level attribution and compatibility checks for MMPR v1.1 images/questions, benchmark-derived items, or generated outputs.

MMPR v1.1 image/question -> four InternVL2.5-series solutions -> split or even merge to at most 12 steps -> 16 continuations per prefix -> source-dependent terminal checks -> mc_i -> '+'/'-' label -> multi-turn VisualPRM training row -> VisualPRM-8B step scorer -> mean step score for Best-of-N selection. The original release omits continuation texts, per-completion checker outputs, seeds, rejected rollouts, and a deterministic item-level construction ledger.
